White.outfitIntent: light/white classroom-clean clothing with character-specific identity details preserved

Black.outfitIntent: black/charcoal/dark-blue clothing with character-specific identity details preserved

Pawn.weaponConcept: small dagger held near the dominant hand
Pawn.propGuidance: small enough to read from the chess camera without covering the face

Rook.weaponConcept: small integrated tower that can slam downward
Rook.propGuidance: tower can be part of the character silhouette, but must not become a base hiding the legs

Knight.weaponConcept: small horse mount with jump anticipation
Knight.propGuidance: horse should look like a compact chess mount, not a chair

Bishop.propGuidance: hands and CastSocket must stay visible for a future beam

Queen.propGuidance: queen cue should stay tasteful and academic

King.propGuidance: pose should preserve professor identity more than fantasy armor
